blocks.text: NAGA CITY, Camarines Sur — The Peñafrancia Fluvial Procession will be held Saturday night (Sept. 19) instead of its usual late-afternoon schedule as organizers wait for the Naga River to rise enough to safely carry the Pagoda bearing the images of Our Lady of Peñafrancia and El Divino Rostro. It will be the first time the annual religious procession will be held after dark. Fr. Francis Tordilla, director of the Cáceres Commission on Communications, said holding the procession at the usual 5 p.m. schedule could cause the Pagoda and accompanying boats to run aground because of the shallow river.
